# Locked dependency notices

Actual license/NOTICE files copied from the 35 distributions installed from the locked macOS Python 3.14.6 environment, including the optional test tools. Each retained text is bound to its distribution, version and SHA-256 in [inventory.json](inventory.json). These are dependency notices, not a license grant for the bridge or public redistribution clearance. Build/setup tools and the operator-supplied Codex executable are not bundled. Other Python/OS lock branches and any future wheel or source distribution require their own artifact/notice reconciliation.
